models_evaluated: HEWIC (Hemodialysis Early Warning and Intervention Copilot)

links.outcome: Three-month mortality in hemodialysis patients, AI-assisted intervention versus control, in a pragmatic randomized trial
links.effect: HEWIC-assisted care reduced three-month mortality by 38.3% (5,216 intervention vs 4,749 control patients, 58 centers), with a more pronounced effect in primary hospitals.
links.quote: Involving 9,965 hemodialysis patients (5,216 intervention and 4,749 control) from 58 dialysis centers, the trial indicates that HEWIC’s high-risk patient identification and treatment recommendation can help reduce the three-month mortality rate of hemodialysis patients by 38.3%, with a more pronounced effect in primary hospitals.

screen.reason: The study conducts a pragmatic randomized clinical trial testing real-world deployment of an AI copilot warning and decision support system versus standard care on patient clinical outcomes (mortality).

primary.practice: AI-guided clinical decision support with physician-in-the-loop intervention
